name: Redcar Beach
notes: Dogs excluded from the section between The Regent and the point where the Esplanade meets Graffenberg Street, May 1–Sep 30. Dogs welcome on lead along the Esplanade year-round. Assistance dogs exempt. Beach either side, towards Coatham and the Stray, is open all year. Redcar and Cleveland Council PSPO, FPN £100.

name: Saltburn Beach
notes: Dogs excluded from the beach to the left of the Pier up to the Hazelgrove beach access, May 1–Sep 30. Dogs welcome on lead along the promenade. Remainder of the beach towards Marske is open all year. Redcar and Cleveland Council PSPO, FPN £100.

name: Coatham Sands
notes: Dogs welcome all year. North of the Redcar exclusion zone, running towards South Gare and the Tees estuary. Backed by dunes designated an SSSI — keep dogs under control near marsh and dune habitat.

name: Marske Sands
notes: Dogs welcome all year. The council PSPO restricts sections of Redcar and Saltburn only — Marske has no listed restrictions, despite some third-party guides claiming otherwise. No facilities on the beach.

name: Skinningrove Beach
notes: Dogs welcome all year. No listed restrictions in the council PSPO. Split by the harbour wall, with Cattersty Sands to the west. Free parking and toilets at the top of the access road.
